description: Submission of details of details of the following external facing materials (including manufacturer's specifications, photographs) pursuant to condition 3; preliminary risk assessment report pursuant to condition 10; site investigation scheme pursuant to condition 11; quantitative risk assessment report pursuant to condition 12; remediation method statement pursuant to condition 13; verification report pursuant to condition 14; onward long-term monitoring methodology report pursuant to condition 15; enhanced sound insulation value DnT,w + Ctr L'nT,w of at least 10dB above the Building Regulations value, for the floor/ceil-ing /wall structures separating different types of rooms/ uses in adjoining dwellings, namely [eg. living room and kitchen above bedroom of separate dwelling] pursuant to condition 16; sound insulation of the floor/ ceiling/walls separating the commercial parts of the premises from dwellings pursuant to condition 17; detailed Demolition and Construction Logistics Plan pursuant to condition 20; Zero Emission MCS certified Air Source Heat Pumps or Electric boilers to be provided for space heating and hot water pursuant to condition 21; refuse storage pursuant to condition 23 of planning permission ref: 2024/02829/FUL granted 16th March 2026.
application_type_full: Approval of details reserved by a condition (discharge)
